scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hello...
Not from around
here, are you?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
你好...
你不是
本地人吧？

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
My name is Bazo Heburiech. I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. As you can see, I'm also not from around here either. I feel as if... We were meant to meet.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
我叫巴佐·赫布里奇。很高興認識你。如您所見，我也不是本地人。我覺得...我們似乎命中註定要相遇。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
If you don't mind, let me tell you a little about this place. When I first got here, I could tell there was something different about
this village.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
如果不介意的話，讓我向您介紹一下這個地方。我剛來的時候，就感覺到這個村莊有些不同尋常。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
For one thing, Umbala is close
to Niflheim, realm of the dead. Because it's so near, some of the people here can actually draw evil power from that realm.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
首先，汶巴拉靠近尼弗海姆，那是亡者的國度。因為距離很近，這裡的一些人實際上能夠汲取那個領域的邪惡力量。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Don't worry, the locals here only use this power to produce specialty items. During my stay here, I too have learned some of those crafting methods.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
別擔心，當地人只利用這種力量來製作特色物品。在我逗留期間，我也學會了一些製作技巧。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
If you like, I'd be willing to show you my skills. Now how does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
如果您願意，我很樂意向您展示我的技藝。您覺得如何？

scripts.text: Sounds good~
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯~

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hmm. For now, you should level
up and get stronger first. Please understand that I mean well when I say that I don't think you're quite ready for my goods.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯。目前，您應該先提升等級，變得更強一些。請理解，我說您還無法駕馭我的商品，是出於好意。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Like I said before, these
goods have some evil power. If you're not strong or experienced enough, you'd be driven insane.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
正如我之前所說，這些商品帶有一些邪惡力量。如果您不夠強大或經驗不足，可能會被其逼瘋。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Once you're ready,
I'll gladly make you
something great~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
等您準備好了，我很樂意為您打造一件傑作~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Excellent! Let me tell you what materials I'll need. There's not that many, but you might want to write them down.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
太好了！讓我告訴您需要哪些材料。數量不多，但您可能想記下來。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
First, I'll need
some basic materials.
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
首先，我需要一些基礎材料。
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵，
以及10個華麗金屬。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Then, I'll need some rare ore to enchant this product. The product's trait will depend on the ore that you use.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
然後，我需要一些稀有礦石來賦予這件物品屬性。物品的特性將取決於您使用的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Please bring me 30 of either Citrin, Turquoise or Agate. Well then, I wish you luck in finding those things and I'll be waiting for you~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
請給我30個黃玉、綠松石或瑪瑙中的任意一種。那麼，祝您尋寶順利，我會在這裡等您~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Oh, okay.
That's fine with me.
But I'll be right here if you
ever change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
哦，好的。
那也沒關係。
如果您改變主意，我就在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hmm...
I sense something different about you. I can't quite describe it, but I get the distince feeling that there's nothing I can do for you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯...
我感覺到您有些不同尋常。我很難描述這種感覺，但我隱約覺得，我似乎無法為您做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
In any case, I wish you safety in your travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
無論如何，祝您旅途平安，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Great...!
Now, let's do this!
Oh, and you should know
now that I can't tell what kind of thing we might get. But let's hope that it'll be good.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
太好了...
好，讓我們開始吧！
哦，您現在應該知道，我無法確定我們會得到什麼樣的物品。但希望它會很好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou feel a mysterious energy gathering around the materials
and the air around them begins to crackle. It seems as if the materials were absorbing
all of the ambient energy.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF您感覺到一股神秘能量在材料周圍聚集，
周圍的空氣開始噼啪作響。似乎材料正在吸收
周圍所有的能量。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFWithout any discernable action from Bazo, the materials began to fuse into each other.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF巴佐沒有任何明顯的動作，材料開始相互融合。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Can you feel that? The materials are now gathering power on their own. It's out of my hands now. All we can do now is wait and pray.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
您感覺到了嗎？材料正在自行聚集力量。現在已超出我的控制範圍了。我們只能等待並祈禱。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe materials finish melding
and the air grows calm.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF材料融合完畢，
空氣恢復了平靜。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Ooooooh! It's done!
We've succeeded! Ah,
this is amazing! Our prayers
must have been answered!
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
噢噢噢！完成了！
我們成功了！啊，
這太不可思議了！我們的祈禱
一定得到了回應！

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
It looks like all those materials turned into some kind of weapon. That ought to be quite useful to you. Now let's see...
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
看起來那些材料變成了一把武器。這應該對您很有用。讓我們來看看...

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Immaterial Sword!
This sword was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
聖劍 混沌！
這把劍天生就是為您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能對您有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Slash!
This mace was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
<死亡騎士>揮砍！
這件鈍器天生就是為您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能對您有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Quadrille!
This mace was born to be yours!
Congratulations and hopefully it will be useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
四重奏！
這件鈍器天生就是為您而生的！
恭喜您，希望它能對您有所幫助。

scripts.text: [Bazo]
scripts.translation: [巴佐]

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Ah, I'm very satisfied with these results. If you wish to have another one, please feel free to visit me anytime. Alright then, enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
啊，我對這些結果非常滿意。如果您想要再來一次，請隨時來找我。那麼，祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Okay, it seems like you're
ready so let's get started. Now, my favorite monsters are Poring, Hode, Obeaune and Minorous.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
好的，看來您準備好了，讓我們開始吧。現在，我最喜歡的魔物是波利、蚯蚓、人魚和米洛斯。

[Bazo]
Here's the first question.
What monster am I thinking
of right now?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
這是第一個問題。
我現在心裡想的是哪種魔物？

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Alright...
Now guess which monster
I'm thinking about right... Now!
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
好的...
現在猜猜我現在心裡想的是哪...哪種魔物！

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Now what monster
am I thinking about?
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation: [巴佐]

read minds, or you've got really bad luck. Either way, we can't try this until we drive away the ill fortune around you.
scripts.translation:

嗯。你要麼不會讀心術，要麼就是運氣實在太差了。
不管怎樣，在開始之前，我們必須先驅散你身邊的黴運。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hm, we need at least
10 {0} to try this
again, so go ahead
and give me that.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯，我們需要至少10個{0}才能再次嘗試，
所以請把它們交給我。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Well, if you want to try this mind reading game again, just come

scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
如果你還想再玩一次這個讀心遊戲，
就帶著材料回來吧。我會等著測試你的運氣。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hmm. Something doesn't
feel right. We must be missing
something. Would you check the
materials you've brought again?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
嗯。感覺哪裡不對勁。
我們一定漏掉了什麼。
你能再檢查一下你帶來的材料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Oh, you've brought all the basic materials. Now, let me check to see if you brought any of the rare ores I asked for...
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
哦，你帶來了所有基礎材料。
現在，讓我看看你是否帶來了我要的那種稀有礦石...

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Hahaha, I asked you to
bring one kind of ore, not all of them. So which one would you
like to use?
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
哈哈，我叫你帶一種礦石，不是全部。
那麼，你想用哪一種？

game. I'll think of a specific monster, and you'll have to
guess what it is from among

scripts.translation:

現在，我們將通過一個簡單的讀心遊戲來測試你的運氣。

scripts.translation:

為了驅散黴運，我將收取你帶來的10個特殊礦石。

Okay, now I need
some time to preprare...

scripts.translation:

好的，現在我需要一些時間來準備...
回頭見！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Excellent! Let me tell you what materials I'll need. There's not that many, but you might want to write them down.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
太好了！讓我告訴您需要哪些材料。數量不多，但您可能想記下來。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
First, I'll need
some basic materials.
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
首先，我需要一些基礎材料。
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵，
以及10個華麗金屬。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Then, I'll need some rare ore to enchant this product. The product's trait will depend on the ore that you use.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
然後，我需要一些稀有礦石來賦予這件物品屬性。物品的特性將取決於您使用的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Please bring me 30 of either Citrin, Turquoise or Agate. Well then, I wish you luck in finding those things and I'll be waiting for you~
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
請給我30個黃玉、綠松石或瑪瑙中的任意一種。那麼，祝您尋寶順利，我會在這裡等您~

scripts.text:
[Bazo]
Oh, okay.
That's fine with me.
But I'll be right here if you
ever change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[巴佐]
哦，好的。
那也沒關係。
如果您改變主意，我就在這裡。

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Umba! Umbaba...umum! Baumba!
Umumumbababaumumbabaumba!
Umbaumbaumbaumbaumhah!
Umumumumumbababababab!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
烏巴！烏巴巴...嗚嗚！
巴烏巴！
嗚嗚烏巴巴巴烏烏巴巴烏巴！
烏巴烏巴烏巴烏巴哈！
嗚嗚嗚嗚烏巴巴巴巴巴巴！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Eh heh heh...
At long last, this
day has come. Finally,
I've earned recognition as
Umbala's greatest artisan!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嘿嘿嘿...
終於，這一天到來了。
我終於獲得了認可，
成為了汶巴拉最偉大的工匠！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Yes yes, I'm ^802A2Athat^000000 Hibilaithan.
And if you bring me the materials, I shall deign to craft one of my masterpieces for you. Bwahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
是的，沒錯，我就是^802A2A那位^000000希比萊桑。
如果你把材料帶給我，我會屈尊為你打造一件我的傑作。哇哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hm? What was that?
Never heard of me?
Please, enough jesting!
I mean, even though I may be a maestro at my craft, there's no need to feel intimidated.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯？剛才說什麼？
沒聽說過我？
拜託，別開玩笑了！
雖然我在工藝上可能是位大師，但沒必要讓你感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now be honest...
Do you want to be
the recipient of my
inspired and oft imitated
handiwork or not?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在老實說...
你想成為我那些靈感迸發、常被模仿的
手工製品的擁有者嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想。

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh...
Your mind is too weak to handle the power of my creations. I'm sorry, but you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢...
你的心智太弱，無法承受我作品中的力量。
很抱歉，你需要更多的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I know it must be unbearable, waiting to own one of my creations. But for your own sake, get stronger first and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我知道等待擁有一件我的作品一定很煎熬。
但為了你好，先變強，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahaha!
Of course you do!
That was a rhetorical question!
But I like your attitude. Now I'm going to tell you what you need
to bring me, so don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈哈！
當然你想！
那是個修辭問句！
但我喜歡你的態度。現在我要告訴你需要帶什麼材料給我，別忘記了。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在，我需要
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵和
10個華麗金屬
作為基礎材料。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'll also need some rare ore to endow my creation with power. Muscovite, Biotite or Pyroxene. Just bring me 30 of one of those kinds of ores.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我還需要一些稀有礦石來賦予我的作品力量。雲母、黑雲母或輝石。只要帶給我其中一種礦石的30個即可。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, I wish you good luck! In the meantime, I shall relax here and wait for your return.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好的，祝你好運！在此期間，我會在這裡放鬆一下，等待你的歸來。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahahaha~!
There's no need
to be modest!
Oh, you adventurers
can be so silly sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈哈哈~！
不需要謙虛！
噢，你們冒險者
有時候真傻。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Well, if you ever muster up the courage to ask me of this favor, come back anytime. Give me the chance to show you my genius!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好吧，如果你鼓起勇氣向我提出這個請求，隨時回來。給我機會展示我的天才！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
...
Ah... I don't feel
like doing ^820A2Aanything^000000
right now. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
...
啊...我現在不想做^820A2A任何事^000000。
稍後再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ah, I sense that all is in readiness. Good, good,
I can begin! Now, don't peek.
I can't risk sharing my
awesome secrets!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
啊，我感覺到一切準備就緒。很好，很好，
我可以開始了。現在，別偷看。
我不能冒險分享我
驚人的秘密！

scripts.text: ^3355FFHibilaithan picked up all the materials and turned his back to you. Although you couldn't get a clear look at what he was doing, his motions were deceptively simple and clumsy looking as you feel a strange energy gather around him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF希比萊桑拿起所有材料，背對著你。雖然你看不清他在做什麼，但他的動作看似簡單笨拙，你感覺到一股奇怪的能量在他周圍聚集。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Umm~ umm~ umm~
Aww~ aww~ aww~
Phew~ phew~ phew~
Woo~ woo~ woo~
Ho~ ho~ ho~
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯~ 嗯~ 嗯~
哇~ 哇~ 哇~
呼~ 呼~ 呼~
嗚~ 嗚~ 嗚~
呵~ 呵~ 呵~

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Haha, it's done!
^333333*Phew*^000000 That was pretty tough, but I'm sure you can't wait to see what we've made. Okay, let's take a look...
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈，完成了！
^333333*呼*^000000 雖然挺費勁的，但我相信你們肯定迫不及待想看看成果了。好了，讓我們來看看...

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh, this is a huge success! But of course, since it's my handiwork, that goes without saying. Hey, this is a weapon... Some sort of... Mailbreaker!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢，大成功！當然啦，畢竟是我的傑作，這是理所當然的。嘿，這是一把武器... 某種... 破甲短劍！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh, this is a huge success! But of course, since it's my handiwork, that goes without saying. Hey, this is a weapon... Some sort of... Swordbreaker!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢，大成功！當然啦，畢竟是我的傑作，這是理所當然的。嘿，這是一把武器... 某種... 削刃短劍！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh, this is a huge success! But of course, since it's my handiwork, that goes without saying. Hey, this is a weapon... Some sort of... Slaughter!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢，大成功！當然啦，畢竟是我的傑作，這是理所當然的。嘿，這是一把武器... 某種... 屠戮！

scripts.text: [Hibilaithan]
scripts.translation: [希比萊桑]

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ah, yet another creation that's a testament to my awesome skills! Come back to me whenever you want me to make something truly great for you. See you around~
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
啊，這又是我高超技藝的證明！如果你想讓我為你打造真正偉大的東西，隨時回來找我。再見~

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, let's get started!
First, we're going to see how
lucky you are today. We'll play this simple game where you guess
which monster I'm thinking of.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好了，開始吧！
首先，我們要看看你今天有多幸運。我們來玩個簡單的遊戲，猜猜我在想哪種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Don't worry, I'll tell you which monsters are my favorite, so this game isn't impossible. If you can guess just one of them right, we'll know your luck is good today!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
別擔心，我會告訴你我最喜歡的魔物有哪些，所以這個遊戲並不是不可能猜中的。如果你能猜中其中一個，就說明你今天運氣很好！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Alright...
My favorite monsters are
Zealotus, Alice, Munak and
Isis. Now... Guess which one
I'm thinking about right now!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好了...
我最喜歡的魔物是
澤洛圖斯、愛麗絲、殭屍和
蛇女伊絲。現在... 猜猜我現在在想哪一個！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay...
Now I'm thinking about a different monster. Or am I? Guess which one!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好了...
現在我在想另一種魔物。還是說不是？猜猜看！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now...
Which monster am
I thinking about?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在...
我在想哪種魔物？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Can you guess which
monster is on my mind now?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
你能猜出我現在心裡想的是哪種魔物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
One more time!
What monster
am I thinking of?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
再來一次！
我在想哪種魔物？

scripts.text: [Hibilaithan]
scripts.translation: [希比萊桑]

scripts.text: Zealotus
scripts.translation: 澤洛圖斯

scripts.text: Alice
scripts.translation: 愛麗絲

scripts.text: Munak
scripts.translation: 穆納克

scripts.text: Isis
scripts.translation: 蛇女伊絲

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Alright, that's it!
Now, this is the order
of the monsters that
I was thinking about...
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好了，就是這些！
現在，這是我剛才想到的魔物的順序...

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Zealotus
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
澤洛圖斯

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Alice
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
愛麗絲

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Munak
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
殭屍

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Isis
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
蛇女伊絲

scripts.text: [Hibilaithan]
scripts.translation: [希比萊桑]

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Amazing...
You must have mental powers or something. You answered correctly
{0} times! Wow, you must have really good luck today!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
太不可思議了...
你一定擁有讀心術之類的能力吧。你答對了{0}次！哇，你今天運氣一定非常好！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Oooh...
This isn't good.
You got all of them ^660000wrong^000000.
We better drive away all of your bad luck with 10 {0}.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢...
情況不妙。
你全都答^660000錯^000000了。
我們最好用10個{0}來驅散你的黴運。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
[Hibilaithan]
Hmm. Something doesn't
feel right. We must be missing
something. Would you check the
materials you've brought again?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯。總覺得哪裡不對勁。
我們一定漏掉了什麼。
你能再檢查一下你帶來的材料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh, you're back earlier than I expected. I see that you have all the basic materials, but did you bring the most important thing...?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢，你回來得比我預想的早。我看到你帶齊了所有基礎材料，但你帶了最重要的東西嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
[Hibilaithan]
Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在，我需要
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵和
10個華麗金屬
作為基礎材料。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
[Hibilaithan]
Eh heh heh...
At long last, this
day has come. Finally,
I've earned recognition as
Umbala's greatest artisan!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嘿嘿嘿...
終於，這一天
到來了。終於，
我獲得了認可，成為了
汶巴拉最偉大的工匠！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
In that case, there's no reason
to delay. Give me a little time to prepare, and then we'll get started on making you something, okay?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
既然如此，就沒有理由拖延了。請給我一點時間準備，然後我們就開始為你打造東西，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
We can't get started until your luck is strong enough, so we'll need to play this game again. If you don't have enough ores, just get some more before coming back.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
在運氣足夠強之前我們無法開始，所以我們需要再玩一次這個遊戲。如果你礦石不夠，請先去多弄一些再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'm not going anywhere,
so there's no rush. Take
your time, I'll be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我哪兒也不去，
所以不用著急。慢慢來，
我會在這裡等你的！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hmm. Something doesn't
feel right. We must be missing
something. Would you check the
materials you've brought again?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯。總覺得哪裡不對勁。
我們一定漏掉了什麼。
你能再檢查一下你帶來的材料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh, you're back earlier than I expected. I see that you have all the basic materials, but did you bring the most important thing...?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢，你回來得比我預想的早。我看到你帶齊了所有基礎材料，但你帶了最重要的東西嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Whoa, you brought all three kinds of those ores I asked for? Haha, we can only use one of them, so go ahead and choose.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哇，你把我要求的三種礦石都帶來了？哈哈，我們只能使用其中一種，所以請選一種吧。

scripts.text: Muscovite
scripts.translation: 雲母

scripts.text: Biotite
scripts.translation: 黑雲母

scripts.text: Pyroxene
scripts.translation: 輝石

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahaha, you only needed to bring one kind of ore, not two. Now, which ore would you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈，你只需要帶一種礦石，而不是兩種。那麼，你想使用哪種礦石？

scripts.text: Muscovite
scripts.translation: 雲母

scripts.text: Biotite
scripts.translation: 黑雲母

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahaha, you only needed to bring one kind of ore, not two. Now, which ore would you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈，你只需要帶一種礦石，而不是兩種。那麼，你想使用哪種礦石？

scripts.text: Muscovite
scripts.translation: 雲母

scripts.text: Pyroxene
scripts.translation: 輝石

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahaha, you only needed to bring one kind of ore, not two. Now, which ore would you like to use?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈，你只需要帶一種礦石，而不是兩種。那麼，你想使用哪種礦石？

scripts.text: Biotite
scripts.translation: 黑雲母

scripts.text: Pyroxene
scripts.translation: 輝石

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
{0}, eh?
Alright, before we start, we need to minimize as much of your negative fortune as we can.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
{0}，是嗎？
好的，在開始之前，我們需要儘可能減少你的黴運。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
We're investing a lot of material and energy into this, so it'd be a pity if we fail, right?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我們投入了大量的材料和精力，如果失敗了就太可惜了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now, if I can craft you something on a day on which your fortune is strong, it should be okay. In order to measure your luck, we'll play a mind reading game.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在，如果我在你運氣好的日子為你打造東西，應該就沒問題了。為了測量你的運氣，我們來玩一個讀心術遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
It's simple. You simply guess the name of the monster I'm thinking about among four choices. If you guess correctly once, then we can get started!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
很簡單。你只需要從我給出的四個選項中猜出我心中的魔物名字。只要猜對一次，我們就可以開始了！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'll be giving you five chances. However, if you get all five wrong, I need to take 10 of the special ore that you brought in order to drive away your misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我會給你五次機會。不過，如果你五次都猜錯了，我就需要拿走你帶來的10塊特殊礦石，以驅散你的黴運。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Sure, that might sound bad,
but it's a small price to pay for insuring success in crafting your special item, right?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
當然，聽起來可能有點糟糕，但為了保佑打造特殊物品成功，這點代價不算什麼，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, I'll need some time to get ready. Come back to me a little later so that I can judge your
luck today~
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好的，我需要一點時間準備。請稍後再來找我，讓我判斷一下你今天的運氣~

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hm...?
It looks like you didn't
bring any of that special
ore I asked for.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯...？
看起來你並沒有帶來我要求的那種特殊礦石。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Please bring 30 of
either, Biotite, Muscovite
or Pyroxene since we need
one of those kinds of ores
for me to start crafting.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
請帶來30塊黑雲母、白雲母或輝石中的任意一種，因為我需要其中一種礦石才能開始打造。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在，我需要
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵和
10個華麗金屬
作為基礎材料。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'll also need some rare ore to endow my creation with power. Muscovite, Biotite or Pyroxene. Just bring me 30 of one of those kinds of ores.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我還需要一些稀有礦石來賦予我的作品力量。雲母、黑雲母或輝石。只要帶給我其中一種礦石的30個即可。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, I wish you good luck! In the meantime, I shall relax here and wait for your return.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好的，祝你好運！在此期間，我會在這裡放鬆一下，等待你的歸來。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Eh heh heh...
At long last, this
day has come. Finally,
I've earned recognition as
Umbala's greatest artisan!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嘿嘿嘿...
終於，這一天到來了。
我終於獲得了認可，
成為了汶巴拉最偉大的工匠！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Yes yes, I'm ^802A2Athat^000000 Hibilaithan.
And if you bring me the materials, I shall deign to craft one of my masterpieces for you. Bwahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
是的，沒錯，我就是^802A2A那位^000000希比萊桑。
如果你把材料帶給我，我會屈尊為你打造一件我的傑作。哇哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hm? What was that?
Never heard of me?
Please, enough jesting!
I mean, even though I may be a maestro at my craft, there's no need to feel intimidated.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
嗯？剛才說什麼？
沒聽說過我？
拜託，別開玩笑了！
雖然我在工藝上可能是位大師，但沒必要讓你感到害怕。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now be honest...
Do you want to be
the recipient of my
inspired and oft imitated
handiwork or not?
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在老實說...
你想成為我那些靈感迸發、常被模仿的
手工製品的擁有者嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我想。

scripts.text: Sorry, I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不需要！

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Ooh...
Your mind is too weak to handle the power of my creations. I'm sorry, but you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
噢...
你的心智太弱，無法承受我作品中的力量。
很抱歉，你需要更多的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I know it must be unbearable, waiting to own one of my creations. But for your own sake, get stronger first and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我知道等待擁有一件我的作品一定很煎熬。
但為了你好，先變強，然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahaha!
Of course you do!
That was a rhetorical question!
But I like your attitude. Now I'm going to tell you what you need
to bring me, so don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈哈！
當然你想！
那是個修辭問句！
但我喜歡你的態度。現在我要告訴你需要帶什麼材料給我，別忘記了。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Now, I'll need
10 Gold,
50 Steel and
10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
現在，我需要
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵和
10個華麗金屬
作為基礎材料。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
I'll also need some rare ore to endow my creation with power. Muscovite, Biotite or Pyroxene. Just bring me 30 of one of those kinds of ores.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
我還需要一些稀有礦石來賦予我的作品力量。雲母、黑雲母或輝石。只要帶給我其中一種礦石的30個即可。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Okay, I wish you good luck! In the meantime, I shall relax here and wait for your return.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好的，祝你好運！在此期間，我會在這裡放鬆一下，等待你的歸來。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Hahahahaha~!
There's no need
to be modest!
Oh, you adventurers
can be so silly sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
哈哈哈哈~！
不需要謙虛！
噢，你們冒險者
有時候真傻。

scripts.text:
[Hibilaithan]
Well, if you ever muster up the courage to ask me of this favor, come back anytime. Give me the chance to show you my genius!
scripts.translation:
[希比萊桑]
好吧，如果你鼓起勇氣向我提出這個請求，隨時回來。給我機會展示我的天才！

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF等一下！您現在攜帶的物品太多了。請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Umba! Umbaba...umum! Baumba!
Umumumbababaumumbabaumba!
Umbaumbaumbaumbaumhah!
Umumumumumbababababab!
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
翁巴！翁巴巴...嗚嗚！邦翁巴！
嗚嗚翁巴巴翁翁巴巴翁巴！
翁巴翁巴翁巴翁巴哈哈！
嗚嗚嗚嗚翁巴巴巴巴巴！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hmm...
I feel something different from you. You are a stranger around here, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
嗯...
我感覺你有些不同。你是這裡的外鄉人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Tabezthan, a veritable fountain of knowledge and a renown genius in Umbala. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請允許我自我介紹。我是塔貝茲桑，是汶巴拉名副其實的知識寶庫和遠近聞名的天才。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I have two disciples: Hibilaithan, who is a fool, and Bazo, who is quite intelligent and shows potential.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
我有兩個弟子：希比萊桑是個笨蛋，而巴佐相當聰明，很有潛力。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Of course, both are very talented and skilled, but I worry about Hibilaithan. He makes many stupid mistakes but he is fairly shameless about his errors.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
當然，兩人都非常有才華和技巧，但我擔心希比萊桑。他經常犯愚蠢的錯誤，而且對自己的錯誤毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I have taught them how to manipulate the ambient energy
here in Umbala in order to create objects. I hear that there is a similar skill in the outside world known to you as alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
我教他們如何操控汶巴拉周圍的環境能量來創造物品。我聽說外面的世界有一種類似的技能，你們稱之為融合試驗。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In any case, do have any use
for my skills? If so, please bring me the materials that I need so that I may be of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
總之，你需要我的技能嗎？如果需要，請帶來我需要的材料，以便我為你服務。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請。

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I regret to say that you are not yet capable of handling my crafts. Please train and acquire greater strength before returning to me. I wish you safety in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
很遺憾，你目前還沒有能力駕馭我的作品。請去鍛鍊並提升實力後再回來找我。祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Good. I ask that you
remember what you need
to bring me so that I may craft something for you. I shall need...
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
很好。請記得你需要帶來什麼材料，以便我為你打造物品。我需要...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
10 Gold,
50 Steel
and 10 Emperium
for the basic materials.
I'll also need a rare ore to enchant my creation.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
10個金幣，
50個鋼鐵
和10個華麗金屬
作為基礎材料。
我還需要一種稀有礦石來賦予我的作品魔力。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In addition, please bring me 30 of either Phlogopite, Peridot or Rose Quartz. Depending on the ore that you choose, my creation will possess a different trait.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
此外，請帶來30塊金雲母、橄欖石或玫瑰石英中的任意一種。根據你選擇的礦石，我的作品將擁有不同的特性。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please be aware that I do not know exactly what item will be produced. There are too many factors in alchemy and there is a limit to anyone's knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請注意，我不知道最終會產出什麼物品。融合試驗的因素太多，任何人的知識都有侷限。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
In other words, we will have to trust to luck. However, we'll have time to talk about that later. For now, please go and gather the necessary materials. I shall be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
換句話說，我們只能靠運氣了。不過，我們稍後再談這個。現在，請去收集必要的材料。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Oh... I see.
It is a little disappointing to hear that, but please return
if you believe that I can be
of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
哦...我明白了。
聽到這個有點令人失望，但如果你認為我能為你服務，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Hm...?
You don't have any
business with me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
嗯...？
你並沒有什麼事要找我吧？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please do not disregard me as merely an old fool. When a man gets older, he can see more clearly into the hearts of others. Please continue what you have been doing, and I wish you good fortune on your journeys.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請不要把我僅僅當作一個糊塗的老頭。人年紀越大，就越能看清他人的內心。請繼續你正在做的事情吧，我祝你在旅途中好運。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Great, I'm ready to begin. Give me a minute to arrange these materials into a mystic circle.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
太好了，我準備好了。請給我一點時間，把這些材料排列成一個神秘的法陣。

scripts.text: ^3355FFHe arranged the materials in a strange circle and began chanting. The air around Tabezthan grew ominously heavy and the materials seemed to surge with newfound energy.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他將材料排列成一個奇怪的圓圈，並開始吟唱。塔貝茲桑周圍的空氣變得沉重而詭異，材料似乎湧動著新生的能量。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please understand that this power is not coming from me. I am merely using my skills to gather power from the realm of the dead and infusing them into these materials.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請理解，這股力量並非來自我。我只是運用我的技巧，從亡靈界汲取力量，並將其注入這些材料中。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Let us pray for good results.
All we can do now is leave the
final result to fate.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
讓我們祈禱能有好結果。
現在我們能做的，
只能將最終結果交給命運了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe materials slowly melded
into each other, combining into a completely new object. It is only
a matter of time before we learn whether you and Tabezthan have succeeded or failed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF材料緩慢地融合在一起，
結合成一個全新的物體。很快，
我們就會知道你和塔貝茲桑是成功了還是失敗了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Caesar's Sword!
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
難以置信！
這是一把極其稀有的武器！是的，我記得它的名字，那是已故的父親告訴我的。這是...利剪劍！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Tirfing!
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
難以置信！
這是一把極其稀有的武器！是的，我記得它的名字，那是已故的父親告訴我的。這是...魔刀 吞神！

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
I don't believe it!
This is such an incredibly rare weapon! Yes, I remember its name from what my late father told me. This is... Sabbath!
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
難以置信！
這是一把極其稀有的武器！是的，我記得它的名字，那是已故的父親告訴我的。這是...安息日！

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔貝茲桑]

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
This mighty weapon is yours to keep. Feel free to come back to me
if you think that I can be of service to you once again.
Farewell for now, brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
這把強大的武器歸你所有。如果你認為我還能為你服務，請隨時回來。
再見了，勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Shall we begin?
I will tell you the names of 4 different monsters. You will be given five chances to predict which monster I am thinking about.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
我們開始吧？
我會告訴你4種不同魔物的名字。你有5次機會來猜測我在想哪一種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
This mind reading game is an effective method of determining whether your fortune is good or bad. Get ready now...
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
這個讀心遊戲是判斷你運氣好壞的有效方法。請做好準備...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
My favorite monsters are
Baphomet, Dark Lord, Bloody
Knight and Stormy Knight. Now,
try to guess which one I am
thinking about.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
我最喜歡的魔物是
巴風特、暗黑之王、血腥騎士
和冰暴騎士。現在，
試著猜猜我在想哪一個。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please try to determine
which monster I'm thinking
of right this moment.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請試著判斷
我此刻正在想的是
哪一種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Now, try to sense
which monster I am
visualizing in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
現在，試著感應
我腦海中正在想像的是
哪一種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Once again, try
and guess what monster
I'm thinking about right now.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
再一次，試著
猜猜我現在正在想的是
哪一種魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Alright, this is
your last chance to
correctly guess which
monster I'm thinking of.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
好了，這是你
最後一次機會
正確猜出我在想的是
哪一種魔物了。

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔貝茲桑]

scripts.text: Baphomet
scripts.translation: 巴風特

scripts.text: Dark Lord
scripts.translation: 暗黑之王

scripts.text: Bloody Knight
scripts.translation: 血腥騎士

scripts.text: Stormy Knight
scripts.translation: 冰暴騎士

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
That's the end of the game. Now, this is the order of the monsters that I had in mind...
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
遊戲結束了。接下來，是我心中設想的魔物順序...

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Baphomet
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
巴風特

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Dark Lord
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
暗黑之王

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Bloody Knight
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
血腥騎士

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Stormy Knight
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
冰暴騎士

scripts.text: [Tabezthan]
scripts.translation: [塔貝茲桑]

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
You have answered {0} times correctly. It appears that your luck is at a high point, and it is an ideal time for me to craft something for you. Give me a little time to prepare, and return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
你答對了{0}次。看來你的運氣正處於巔峰，這正是我為你打造某物的絕佳時機。請給我一點時間準備，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Unfortunately, you weren't able to guess any of them correctly. It seems that your luck is charged with negative energy. We'll need to expel this bad luck with 10 of your Phologopite.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
很遺憾，你一次都沒猜對。看來你的運氣充滿了負面能量。我們需要用10個雲母來驅散這股厄運。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Umm...
You do not seem to
have enough Rose Quartz.
Please try to gather at
least 30 of them and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
嗯...
你的玫瑰石英似乎不夠。
請至少收集30個，
然後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
You've returned to me earlier than I've expected. I sense that you've brought all the basic materials, but did you bring enough special ore as well?
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
你比我預期的回來得早。我感覺到你帶來了所有的基礎材料，但你也帶了足夠的特殊礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Bring me...
10 Gold,
50 Steel
and 10 Emperium.
I'll also need a rare ore to enchant my creation.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請帶來...
10個黃金，
50個鋼鐵
和10個華麗金屬。
我還需要一種稀有礦石來給我的作品附魔。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
[Tabezthan]
Hmm...
I feel something different from you. You are a stranger around here, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
嗯...
我感覺你有些不同。你是這裡的外鄉人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Do not be disheartened. Losing 10 {0} is much better than losing 30 on a failed crafting attempt.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
不要灰心。損失10個{0}總比在打造失敗時損失30個要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Please come back with 30 Phologopite, and we shall try this mind reading game once again. I shall be waiting for you right here.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
請帶著30個雲母回來，我們再試一次這個讀心遊戲。我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Umm...
You do not seem to
have enough Rose Quartz.
Please try to gather at
least 30 of them and then
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
嗯...
你的玫瑰石英似乎不夠。
請至少收集30個，
然後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
You've returned to me earlier than I've expected. I sense that you've brought all the basic materials, but did you bring enough special ore as well?
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
你比我預期的回來得早。我感覺到你帶來了所有的基礎材料，但你也帶了足夠的特殊礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tabezthan]
Ah, you've brought all three. However, we can only use one kind of ore at a time, so please choose just one.
scripts.translation:
[塔貝茲桑]
啊，你三種都帶來了。不過我們一次只能使用一種礦石，所以請只選擇一種。

scripts.text: Phlogopite
scripts.translation: 雲母

scripts.text: Peridot
scripts.translation: 橄欖石

scripts.text: Rose Quartz
scripts.translation: 玫瑰石英

scripts.text:

[Bill Thayer]

scripts.translation:
[比爾·塞耶]
我不再為任何人打造武器了。也許我曾經是著名的武器匠，但自從我的兒子們去世後，我就無法再從事任何工作...

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
There was a skillful
weaponsmith in Al De Baran
who had 4 sons. All of them were known throughout the land for their skill in weapon crafting.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
艾爾帕蘭曾有一位技藝高超的武器匠，
他有四個兒子。他們全都在武器鍛造方面享有盛名。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Tragically, all of the sons died in their attempt to create a powerful weapon. Only the father survived the accident.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
悲劇的是，所有兒子都在嘗試打造強大武器時去世了。只有父親在那次事故中倖存下來。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Because of that incident, the weaponsmith retired and went into hiding. No one ever saw the weapon he and his sons were developing.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
因為那次事件，武器匠退休並隱居起來。沒有人見過他和兒子們正在開發的武器。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
I don't think his sons
were able to peacefully enter the afterlife after sacrificing so much and having to leave their goal unfulfilled...
scripts.translation:
[市民]
我不認為他的兒子們
在犧牲了這麼多，卻未能實現目標後，
能平靜地進入來世...

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Meeting a person in the realm of the dead is impossible. But I've heard that if you were able to meet a dead person, you'd find that he wouldn't have all of his memories.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
在死後世界遇到一個人是不可能的。但我聽說，如果你能遇到一個死去的人，你會發現他並沒有保留所有的記憶。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
But if you brought him something that reminded him of his life, he'd get his memories back for a little while. Of course, you'd have to actually meet someone in the netherworld to find out for sure.
scripts.translation:
[市民]
但如果你給他帶一些能讓他想起生前事物的東西，他就能短暫地找回記憶。當然，你必須真的在冥界遇到某個人，才能確定這一點。

scripts.text:
[Citizen]
Huh...
I know what I'm talking about might be a little morbid, but even the most trivial information might come in handy someday, right?
scripts.translation:
[市民]
嗯...
我知道我說的可能有點晦氣，但哪怕是最微不足道的資訊，說不定哪天也能派上用場，對吧？

scripts.text: ^3355FFWait a second! Right now, you're carrying too many items with you. Please come back after putting some of your things into Kafra Storage.^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Hey...
How did somebody like
you get all the way over here?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]

像你這樣的人，是怎麼一路走到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]

scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
光看你那張稚嫩的臉，我就知道你很弱。你最好趕緊離開這裡，去變得強大起來，別想著再回來了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
In life, I was known as Kayron.
But now I'm just another ghost wandering around this realm of
the dead. Without a body, I feel
so useless.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]

但現在，我只是在這個死後世界遊蕩的又一個幽靈。沒有身體，我感到自己毫無用處。

scripts.text: Show interest.

scripts.text: Ignore him.

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Useless...
Absolutely useless...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
毫無用處...
完全毫無用處...

scripts.text:

you. Almost as if you were
here with some sort of goal.
scripts.translation:

我感覺到你身上有某種氣息。就好像你是帶著某種目的來到這裡的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'm surprised...
And a little envious.
It can be said that most
in Niflheim come here with
little or no purpose.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Kayron]

The time has come for
me to reveal the results

我完成了那個導致我死亡的實驗！我簡直不敢相信！我打造了這把...克萊伊特斧！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

The stuff you're carrying

Hm, let me take a look, please...

scripts.translation:

我可以用這些來鍛造武器！你怎麼知道這些是我需要的材料？總之，這太棒了！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright, I'll keep my end of the bargain. Give me the materials
and some time to finish preparing. I'll talk to you later, okay?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
好吧，我會信守承諾的。把材料給我，
給我一點時間完成準備。稍後再見，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Well, I'm sorry to say that you lost. We have no choice but to drive away your bad luck with
some of the ore you brought!
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
很遺憾，你輸了。我們別無選擇，
只能用你帶來的一些礦石來驅散你的黴運！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright, let's try this again. Go and get the materials we need
and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
好吧，讓我們再試一次。去收集我們需要的材料，
然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I can't seem to recall the rest
of the materials I need. This is beginning to get really frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我似乎想不起還需要哪些材料了。這開始變得非常令人沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I mean, me and my father used to know this stuff like it was second nature. What's wrong with me...?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我是說，我和神父以前對這些東西瞭如指掌。我到底怎麼了...？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Oh...!
I had no idea you were such a reliable person! You brought the things I've asked for pretty quickly!
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
哦...！
我沒想到你是這麼可靠的人！你很快就帶來了我要的東西！

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
But I still can't remember the rest of the things that I'll be needing. I'm really sorry...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
但我還是想不起還需要哪些東西。真的很抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Is there any way to get more of my memory back? In the meantime, let me keep these materials. I promise they'll be used to make a good weapon for you.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
有沒有什麼辦法能讓我恢復更多記憶？在此期間，讓我先收下這些材料。我保證它們會被用來為你打造一把好武器。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'll need a lot of materials, but let me remind you of some of
the necessary things that I can actually remember.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我需要很多材料，但讓我提醒你一些我確實記得的必要物品。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
So far, I know I'll need
2 Hammer of Blacksmith
1 Emperium Anvil
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
目前，我知道我需要
2個高階鐵砧
1個華麗金屬鐵砧
1朵幻想花
和20個金幣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I know there were a few more
things that are crucial to this weapon's construction, but...
I can't seem to concentrate hard enough to remember.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我知道還有幾樣東西對這把武器的製作至關重要，但是...
我似乎無法集中精神去回憶。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright...
I just remembered
most of the things
I need to make you
a great weapon.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
好了...
我終於想起來
製作一把好武器
所需的大部分東西了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I believe it's fair to let you know that I can't guarantee what weapon will be produced from this work since, quite frankly, I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我覺得有必要告訴你，我無法保證最終會打造出什麼樣的武器，因為說實話，我也記不清了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
So far, I know I'll need
2 Hammer of Blacksmith
1 Emperium Anvil
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
目前，我知道我需要
2個高階鐵砧
1個華麗金屬鐵砧
1朵幻想花
和20個金幣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Bring those items to me first. I'm pretty sure there was something else I'll be needing, but I can't seem to remember. This memory
of mine is beginning to worry me a little bit...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
先把那些物品帶給我吧。我確信還需要別的東西，但我就是想不起來。我的記憶開始讓我有點擔心了...

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Anyway, I'll be waiting for you here while you go out and collect those things. Be careful, alright?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
總之，我會在這裡等你去收集那些東西。小心點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
In life, I was known as Kayron.
But now I'm just another ghost wandering around this realm of
the dead. Without a body, I feel
so useless.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
生前，人們叫我凱隆。
但現在，我只是在這個死後世界遊蕩的又一個幽靈。沒有身體，我感到自己毫無用處。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
There's nothing I can do.
I'm... Um... I'm...?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我無能為力。
我...嗯...我是...？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I'm utterly helpless here.
Right, right! My father always used to say that! I guess my brothers and I take after our father in a lot of ways.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我完全幫不上忙。
沒錯，沒錯！我父親以前總是這麼說！我想我和兄弟們在很多方面都像他。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
My mind's been so hazy.
I forgot that I even used
to be a living human.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我的腦子一直昏昏沉沉的。
我甚至忘了自己曾經是個活生生的人。
^333333*嘆息...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Still, that little memory has brought me a little peace of
mind. I really appreciate that.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
不過，這點記憶還是讓我稍微安心了一些。真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
I used to be a weaponsmith
when I was alive, so if you like, I can forge something nice for you. You'll have to bring me the materials, though.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
我生前是個鐵匠，所以如果你願意，我可以為你打造一件不錯的裝備。不過，你得把材料帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
You understand that being
dead sort of restricts my mobility. Still, it's actually useful to be stuck in Niflheim. This place is filled with some strange energy that will help in my smithing.
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
你知道，死了之後行動會受到限制。不過，被困在尼弗海姆其實也有好處。這裡瀰漫著一種奇怪的能量，對我的鍛造很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Even though experimental
smithing got me killed, I won't have to worry about it this time. After all, I'm already dead! Hahahah~
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
雖然實驗性鍛造讓我丟了命，但這次我不用擔心了。畢竟，我已經死了！哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Alright, just give me a little time so that I can try to remember the things that I'll need, alright?
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
好了，給我一點時間，讓我試著回憶一下需要哪些東西，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kayron]
Huh...?
What did you just say?
I'm sorry, I'm trying to remember something my father always used
to say...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
咦...？
你剛才說什麼？
抱歉，我正在努力回憶我父親以前常說的一句話...

[Kayron]
Huh...?
I can't remember what I was going to say. M-my memories! I... I can't seem to recollect...
scripts.translation:
[凱隆]
嗯...？
我忘了我剛才想說什麼。我的...我的記憶！我...我似乎想不起來了...

How...
the hell...?
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
怎...怎麼可能...？

What's a living person doing here? Stick around and I guarantee that you won't be alive much longer. Come on, you don't want to end up like me. Hurry and get out of here!

活人跑到這裡來幹什麼？留下來吧，我保證你活不了多久。快走吧，你不想變成我這樣的。趕緊離開這裡！

Damn it...
I didn't want to die!
scripts.translation:

該死...
我不想死啊！

scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
嗯，活著的生物其實都不想死，但我當時離完成我想做的事只差一步了。啊，青春啊...

I remember hearing

青春...

你寫的是...

[Reyghema]

scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
不錯。你贏了{0}次。你的運氣真好，這下我們總算可以結束這些無聊的事了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]

now, and talk to me a little later, alright?

[雷格瑪]

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Damn...
I should be happy I won, but that just means your luck is bad and
we need to do this again.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
該死...
我雖然贏了，但這隻能說明你運氣太差，
我們還得再來一次。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
I'm sorry, but I'll need to take a bunch of one of your ores to get rid of your bad luck. Come back with all of the ore we'll need so we can test your luck again, alright?
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
抱歉，我需要拿走你身上的一些礦石來消除你的黴運。
請把我們需要的礦石全部帶回來，這樣我們才能再次測試你的運氣，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Arrrgh!
I still can't
remember what
I need yet! I swear,
this is killing me!
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
啊！
我還是想不起來
我需要什麼！天哪，
這簡直要了我的命！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
...

[Reyghema]
...
......

[Reyghema]
Damn.
Damn, damn, damn!
'Killing me?!' I'm already dead!
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
該死。
該死，該死，該死！
“要了我的命”？我早就死了！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Good work, you've brought everything I asked for. However, there's been a bit of a snafu in the plans...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
幹得好，你帶齊了我要求的所有東西。不過，計劃出現了一點小意外...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
The original plan was that I'd remember everything else I need once you came back with this stuff. But I didn't.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
原本的計劃是，等你帶著這些東西回來時，我會想起其他所有需要的東西。但我沒有想起來。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Just give me some time to think about it some more. For now, let
me hold on to the things you've brought. You've got my word that I'll be using these to make a weapon for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
請給我點時間再想想。暫時先讓我保管你帶來的這些東西吧。
我向你保證，我會用它們為你打造一把武器。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
I better remind
you what things I'll
be needing. If you need
to, write it all down.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
我得提醒你一下我需要哪些東西。
如果你需要的話，把它們都記下來。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower
and 20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
1個華麗金屬鐵砧，
2個高階鐵砧，
1朵幻想花
和20個金幣...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
There were a few more critically important things, but I can't seem to recall them right now...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
還有幾樣至關重要的東西，但我現在怎麼也想不起來了...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Alright, you're back. I remember most of the things I'll be needing. Go ahead and note this down.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
好了，你回來了。我想起了大部分需要的東西。請把這些記下來。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower
and 20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
1個華麗金屬鐵砧，
2個高階鐵砧，
1朵幻想花
和20個金幣...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
There were a few other
important things, but I can't seem to remember what they were. Hopefully, by the time you come back with the items I'll know by then.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
還有幾樣重要的東西，但我實在想不起來是什麼了。
希望等你帶著物品回來時，我就能想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
For now, just go and bring back the things I asked for. The sooner, the better. Hurry, I don't know how long my memories will last...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
現在，先去把我要求的東西帶回來吧。越快越好。
快去吧，我不知道我的記憶還能維持多久...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Damn it...
I didn't want to die!
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
該死...
我不想死啊！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Well, nothing that's alive really wants to die, but I was so close to finishing what I wanted to do. Ah, youth...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
嗯，活著的生物其實都不想死，但我當時離完成我想做的事只差一步了。啊，青春啊...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Youth...
Enjoy your youth...
I remember hearing
something like that,
but there was more to it...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
青春...
享受你的青春...
我記得聽過
類似的話，
但後面還有內容...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
...

[Reyghema]
...
.......
Enjoy your youth.
Live without regret.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
...
.......
享受你的青春。
活得無怨無悔。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Of course...
My father, Bill Thayer used to say that all the time! That's right!
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
當然...
我的父親，比爾·塞耶以前總是這麼說！沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Hey you, thanks for refreshing my memory. It's all coming back to me. I used to be a weaponsmith, but I regret never finishing my final project...
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
嘿，謝謝你幫我找回了記憶。一切都想起來了。
我曾經是一名武器匠，但我遺憾地沒有完成我的最後一個專案...

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
You just gotta help me realize
my final goal. Even if I am dead,
I really wanna complete the experiment that got me killed.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
你只需要幫我實現最後的願望。
即使我已經死了，
我也真的想完成那個導致我死亡的實驗。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
All you need to do for now is bring me the things I need. I don't think I'll be able to gather much, being here in Niflheim and all.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
現在你只需要把需要的東西帶給我。
既然我身處尼弗海姆，我想我也無法收集到多少東西了。

scripts.text:
[Reyghema]
Come back a little later.
By then, I should remember what kinds of things I'll need.
scripts.translation:
[雷格瑪]
請稍後再來。
到時候，我應該就能想起自己需要哪些東西了。

It looks like you want to ask me something. Heh, my customers used to have that look on that faces too when I worked as a weaponsmith...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看起來你好像有什麼事想問我。呵呵，我以前當武器匠的時候，顧客們露出這種表情時，通常也是有什麼事要拜託我...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Back during those days,
I never accepted money for my work. Father always used to say, 'Never accept payment to forge a good weapon. It... It...'
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在那段日子裡，
我從不收取工錢。神父總是說，
“打造好武器，絕不能收取報酬。它...它...”

rest of that saying?!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
後面是什麼來著？
為什麼我想不起來
那句話的後半段了？！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It's so weird.
How could I forget
something I used to
say all the time? I...
I hate being dead!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
真奇怪。
我以前經常說的話，
怎麼會忘記呢？我...
我討厭死亡！

scripts.text:
[Hein]

the rest of that saying?!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
該死！為什麼我想不起來
那句話的後半段？！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Mm? I can tell you've here because you've got something to do. It's weird enough to see a living being here, and weirder still to see one who's here for a good reason.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯？我知道你來到這裡，是因為你有事要做。在這裡見到活人已經夠奇怪了，而帶著正當理由來的活人就更奇怪了。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Do me a favor
and stay alive.
Take it from me,
there's no pleasure
at all in being dead.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
幫我個忙，
好好活著。
相信我，
死亡沒有任何樂趣可言。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
You're here!
I just finished my work!
You want to see it, don't you?
Now, take a deep breath...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
你來了！
我剛完成作品！
你想看看，對吧？
現在，深呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Haha~!
This is great!
Finally, my life's
work is complete!
This weapon's name
is Edge!
scripts.translation:
[海因]

太棒了！
終於，我畢生的
作品完成了！
這把武器的名字
是“Edge”！

scripts.text:
[Hein]

It looks like this is goodbye for now. I can already feel my memory getting hazier. Haha, being dead is definitely not good.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯...
看來現在要告別了。我已經感覺到記憶變得模糊了。哈哈，死亡確實不好。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Thank you for your help. If you come back and help me retrieve
my memories again, I'll try to help you as well. So long, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
謝謝你的幫助。如果你回來幫我找回記憶，我也會盡力幫助你。再見，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Mm...?
The stuff you brought seems to be just what I need to finish my work. Let me have a look at them...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯...？
你帶來的東西似乎正是我完成作品所需的。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Wow...
How did you know the materials
I needed? It's almost too good to be true! Alright, we're that much closer to finishing my life's work!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
哇...
你怎麼知道我需要這些材料？
簡直好得難以置信！好吧，我們離完成畢生作品又近了一步！

scripts.text:
[Hein]

scripts.translation:
[海因]
哦，對了。光靠技術是不夠的，還需要你的運氣。首先，我們要測試一下你今天運氣好不好。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[海因]
但如果你輸了，我就得把你帶來的礦石扔掉一些，以驅散你的黴運。

When I tell you to, write down 'Rock,' 'Paper' or 'Scissors.' I'll do the same thing, and we'll compare our results at the end, okay? Let's begin!

寫下了這些答案...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Let's see...
You won {0} times.
You're really good at game!
Yes, your luck is at its highest!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
讓我看看...
你贏了{0}次。
你真的很擅長玩遊戲！
是的，你的運氣好到了極點！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
As promised, I will craft a weapon for you. Give me the materials now, and come back when I'm finished preparing.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
如我所承諾的，我會為你打造一把武器。現在把材料給我，等我準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, you lost.
I'm sorry, but we
need to expel the
misfortune around you
with the ore you've brought...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯，你輸了。
很抱歉，我們需要用你帶來的礦石
來驅散你身邊的厄運...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Okay, I'll wait here.
Come back with the materials
I need and we'll try this again.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
好的，我會在這裡等著。
帶著我需要的材料回來，我們再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Would you give me more time to remember the materials? I can't seem to focus very well. It might have to do with the fact that I'm dead...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
你能給我多一點時間回憶一下材料嗎？我似乎無法集中注意力。這也許是因為我已經死了...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
I had a much better memory when I was alive I'm sure. My father would quiz me on this stuff all the time...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
我相信我活著的時候記憶力要好得多。我父親總是考我這些東西...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Hey, you brought everything I asked for already. You must be ready to get started!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嘿，你已經把我要求的所有東西都帶來了。看來你準備好開始了！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Sadly, we can't begin until
I remember the rest of the things we need. I can't for the life of me remember the most important materials...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
遺憾的是，在我記起我們需要的所有東西之前，我們無法開始。我無論如何也想不起最重要的材料...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, for now, let me keep the things you've brought to me. I promise that I'll use this stuff to make you a good weapon once everything is ready.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
那麼，暫時先把你帶來的東西留在我這裡吧。我保證，等一切準備就緒，我會用這些材料為你打造一把好武器。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
For sure I'll need
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Emperium Anvil,
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
我肯定需要
2個高階鐵砧，
1個華麗金屬鐵砧，
1朵幻想花和
20個金幣...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
So for now,
go ahead and
bring that stuff
to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
所以暫時，
請把這些東西
帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
I take it that you
really want me to make
you a weapon. For a former
weaponsmith like me, that in
itself is a great compliment.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看來你真的很想讓我為你打造一把武器。對於像我這樣曾經的武器匠來說，這本身就是一種極大的讚美。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Alright, I'll need...
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
好的，我需要...
1個華麗金屬鐵砧，
2個高階鐵砧，
1朵幻想花和
20個金幣...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
There were 3 other things,
but I'm not too sure what they were. I guess a bunch of memories from my life are still missing.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
還有另外3樣東西，
但我不太確定是什麼。我想我生命中的一些記憶仍然缺失。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I'm sorry to ask this of you, but would you please go out and figure out what those things are? I'm sure you can find some clue in the land of the living.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 很抱歉要麻煩你，但你能不能出去弄清楚那些東西是什麼？我相信你在生者的國度一定能找到一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
While you do that, I'll try my best to remember what else I need to make this weapon.
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在你做這件事的時候，我會盡力回憶打造這把武器還需要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hein]
It looks like you want to ask me something. Heh, my customers used to have that look on that faces too when I worked as a weaponsmith...
scripts.translation:
[海因]
看起來你好像有什麼事想問我。呵呵，我以前當武器匠的時候，顧客們露出這種表情時，通常也是有什麼事要拜託我...

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Back during those days,
I never accepted money for my work. Father always used to say, 'Never accept payment to forge a good weapon. It... It...'
scripts.translation:
[海因]
在那段日子裡，
我從不收取工錢。神父總是說，
“打造好武器，絕不能收取報酬。它...它...”

scripts.text:
[Hein]
That's right!
And you need luck when you're creating high quality weapons!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
沒錯！
而且打造高品質武器時，你還需要運氣！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Oh... crap.
I'm a dead man.
I just realized.
Or remembered.
Perhaps I'm brain
dead too, huh?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
噢...糟糕。
我死定了。
我剛剛才意識到。
或者說想起來了。
也許我的腦子也死掉了吧？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Well, I must be a lucky dead man for remembering some of my past, right? Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嗯，既然能想起過去的一些事，我肯定是個幸運的死人吧？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Right, I died while trying to finish my weapon research. Maybe this is fate's way of allowing me to finish my uncompleted work?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
對了，我是在試圖完成武器研究時死的。也許這是命運允許我完成未竟之業？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Hey, let me ask you a favor. Would you bring the materials I need to finish my research? If I succeed, the finished product is yours to keep. All yours!
scripts.translation:
[海因]
嘿，讓我求你個忙。你能幫我帶齊完成研究所需的材料嗎？如果成功，成品歸你所有。全歸你！

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Take your time
and think about it.
It can't be that bad
of a deal... Right?
scripts.translation:
[海因]
慢慢考慮吧。
這交易應該不虧...對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hein]
Wha...?

為什麼我想不起來
那句話的後半段了？！

scripts.text:

It's so weird.
How could I forget
something I used to
say all the time? I...
I hate being dead!

怎麼會忘記呢？我...

Hah...!
A living person!
But not for long!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
哈...！
活人！
但你也活不了多久了！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I hope you came here with some strong allies. Judging from your strength, there's no way you'll survive in this kind of place on
your own, you know.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
我希望你帶了強力盟友過來。以你的實力，在這種地方獨自生存是不可能的，你知道嗎。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It's so frustrating being dead.
I can't do anything without a body, no matter how hard I try.
scripts.translation:

沒有身體，無論怎麼努力都什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]

scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
看起來你不像是隨便逛逛的。你是有特定目的才來的，對吧？但亡靈國度能給活人提供什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Take a look at this!
In just a short time, I made something with the materials you've given me. You're curious what the result is, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
看看這個！
只用了一小會兒，我就用你給我的材料做出了東西。你很好奇結果是什麼，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Waltboughst never fails!
With my skill and your luck, there was zero probability for failure. Behold... Byeollungum!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
沃爾特博格斯特從不失敗！
憑藉我的技藝和你的運氣，失敗率為零。請看...首領之劍！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Waltboughst never fails!
With my skill and your luck, there was zero probability for failure. Behold... Exorcise!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
沃爾特博格斯特從不失敗！
憑藉我的技藝和你的運氣，失敗率為零。請看...驅魔！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I'm a genius!
Hahahahahahahaha!
I succeeded where my brothers
could not! Mwahahahaha ha ha ...ha?
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
我是天才！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
我做到了我兄弟做不到的事！嗚哈哈哈哈哈 哈 哈...哈？

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Damn, I can feel that fuzziness in my head again. This can't be good. But still, I was able to prove my genius even after I died.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
該死，我腦子裡又出現那種模糊感了。這不好。但即便如此，我也在死後證明了自己的天才。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I'm sure that if you come back and help me retrieve my memories, I can be of service to you again. But for now, I must thank you, even if I do end up forgetting everything...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
我相信如果你回來幫我找回記憶，我還能再次為你效勞。但現在，即使我最終會忘記一切，我也必須感謝你的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Yes...
It will be your job to remember the accomplishments of Waltboughst, and that he was a weaponsmith ahead of his time. Good bye for now, adventurer...

be able to start work
on this really soon.

[沃爾特博格斯特]
現在我們需要測試你的運氣。為此，我們需要玩'^660000石頭、剪刀、布^000000'。我是認真的...

[Waltboughst]

scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]

[Waltboughst]
Excellent. You won {0} times,
so your luck must be really high.
That means we can begin~!

[沃爾特博格斯特]
太棒了。你贏了{0}次，
看來你的運氣真的很好。
那麼，我們可以開始了~！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Leave the ores here and give
me some time to complete my preparations. Come back later, and I should be finished.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
把礦石留在這裡，給我一點時間
來完成準備工作。稍後再回來，
那時我應該就準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
You lost...
I'm sorry, but we
need to repel the bad
luck by throwing away
some of your ores...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
你輸了...
很抱歉，為了驅散厄運，
我們需要扔掉你的一些礦石...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Gather the required ores again,
and come back to me so we can test your luck. I'll be waiting right here.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
重新收集所需的礦石，
然後回來找我，讓我們測試一下你的運氣。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Why can't I remember...?!
A good weaponsmith is supposed
to know these things by heart!
When I was alive, I had no such recall problems...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
為什麼我記不起來...？！
優秀的武器匠人應該
對這些東西倒背如流才對！
我活著的時候，可沒有這種記憶問題...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
If Father were
to see me now, I'm
sure he'd be ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
如果神父現在看到我，
他肯定會感到羞愧的...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
You brought everything I needed already? That's great, but somehow, I can't still remember the other materials I need...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
你已經帶來了我需要的所有東西？
那太好了，但不知為何，
我還是記不起還需要其他什麼材料...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Tell you what. Let me hold on to these things, and I promise you that I'll use them to create a weapon for you. In the meantime, we need to figure out the rest of the necessary materials...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
這樣吧。讓我先保管這些東西，
我向你保證，我會用它們為你打造一把武器。
在此期間，我們需要弄清楚還缺哪些必要的材料...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
For now, bring
the basic things...
1 Emperium Anvil,
2 Hammer of Blacksmith,
1 Illusion Flower and
20 Gold...
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
現在，先帶來基礎的東西...
1個華麗金屬鐵砧，
2個高階鐵砧，
1朵幻想花和
20個金幣...

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I just remembered some of the most basic materials we need for me to make a weapon for you.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
There were a few other necessary materials, but I need some time to focus and remember what they were.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
還有幾種必要的材料，但我需要時間集中精力回憶一下是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It's so frustrating being dead.
I can't do anything without a body, no matter how hard I try.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
死了真讓人沮喪。
沒有身體，無論怎麼努力都什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It's funny, you know. My father always used to say, 'Trying your best won't always result in success...' Um, that's ... Huh? There was more, I think.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
說來好笑，你知道嗎。我父親常說，“盡力未必能成功...”嗯，後面是...咦？後面還有話，我想。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Yes! That was it!
But that's no excuse!
Every successful man in
history has tried his best!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
沒錯！就是這個！
但這不是藉口！
歷史上每一個成功人士
都付出了最大的努力！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
I remember now...
I got myself killed trying to make some kind of special weapon.
Heh heh, but not this time!
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
我想起來了...
我生前曾試圖打造某種特殊武器，結果把自己搞死了。
嘿嘿，不過這次不會了！

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
We must have been fated to meet. Yes, adventurers of great strength and men of genius naturally attract each other.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
看來我們是命中註定要相遇的。是的，強大的冒險者和天才工匠自然會相互吸引。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
Lend me your power.
Help me complete the experiment
I left unfinished in life, and I will let you keep the finished product. All I wish to do is complete my life's work.
scripts.translation:
[沃爾特博格斯特]
借給我你的力量。
幫我完成生前未竟的實驗，我會把成品留給你。我只希望完成我畢生的傑作。

scripts.text:
[Waltboughst]
It seems that being deceased has impaired my rententive faculties. Give me some time to remember the things I'll need to conduct my experiment. We shall talk later.
